mods.name: Gems Mod
mods.description: Enriches your world with more diamond like ores.

releases.notes:
### Changes:

- Made all gems harder to obtain using loot pools.
- Improved Black Diamond material durability.
- Recolored black diamond texture.
- Made textures feel slightly more bta.
- Added things to TODO list.

### Dependencies:

- [HalpLibe](https://github.com/Turnip-Labs/bta-halplibe) >=[2.3.1](https://github.com/Turnip-Labs/bta-halplibe/releases/tag/2.3.1)
- [AtlasLib](https://github.com/dotBlueShoes/bta-AtlasLib) >=[0.4.8](https://github.com/dotBlueShoes/bta-AtlasLib/releases/tag/0.4.8)
- [PrismaticLibe](https://github.com/UselessBullets/BTA_Babric_PrismaticLibe) >=[0.2.2](https://github.com/UselessBullets/BTA_Babric_PrismaticLibe/releases/tag/v2.2.0)

releases.notes:
### Additions:

- Different stone variants for gem ores.
- Sample descriptions (looking for suggestions).

### Changes:

- Increased dependency min-version for "atlas_lib" to "0.4.8".

### Fixes:

- Diamond ore now drops the same way as other gem ores.
- More accurate malachite armor model color.

### Soon:

- Config option to change drops.
- Config option to change gen.

### Dependencies:

- [HalpLibe](https://github.com/Turnip-Labs/bta-halplibe) >=[2.3.1](https://github.com/Turnip-Labs/bta-halplibe/releases/tag/2.3.1)
